newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end limit, near limit down.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end limit, near limit down.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed limit to near limit down on a bearish USDA crop production report, traders said.
Soyoil Monday will trade with expanded 1.5 cent per lb limits and soymeal with expanded $15.00 per ton limits.
USDA early Friday said 1996 U.S. soybean production would total 2.346 billion bushels, above an average trade estimate for 2.287 billion and above USDA's September forecast for 2.270 billion.

USDA also raised its estimate for 1996-97 U.S. soyoil carryout to 2.235 billion lbs from the September outlook for 2.060 billion. The government also hiked its estimate for 1996-97 U.S. soymeal carryover to 225,000 tons from 200,000.
Fund selling totaled at least 2,500 contracts in soymeal and 3,000 in soymeal, the traders said.
Soyoil closed 0.80 to 1.01 cent per lb lower, with limitless October down 1.01 cent at 22.29 cents per lb. Soymeal was $3.50 to $12.00 per ton lower, with limitless October down $12.00 at $236.70.
